fullPassage: Parenting experts say children need to learn independence and resilience. But cities and suburbs don't offer safe walk and bike routes to school, malls kick teenagers out on the weekends, and free time disappears under a spreadsheet of activities. All of those "musts" take more of the parents' time or money to navigate, because the child can't do it on their own. As Darby Saxbe, a clinical psychologist, recently wrote in the New York Times, "underparenting requires structural change." Unlike most political experts, she's not just talking about economic policies like family leave and government-supported childcare. She's talking about actual physical structures, and the cultural change required to populate them. We need to "build back our tolerance for children in public spaces," she writes, "and create safe environments where lightly supervised kids can move around freely."

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 아이들의 독립을 위해 사회 구조와 문화의 변화가 필요하다

det.korean: 주제: 아이 독립을 위한 구조적/문화적 변화 필요
det.analysis:
✅ ① structural + cultural change for independence: 글 전체 주제
❌ ② not just economic policies
❌ ③ structural change (개인 양육이 아님)
❌ ④ 환경: 다른 주제
det.tip: structural change + cultural change = 사회 변화

questions.passage: Parenting experts say children need to learn independence and resilience. But cities and suburbs don't offer safe walk and bike routes to school, malls kick teenagers out on the weekends, and free time disappears under a spreadsheet of activities. All of those "musts" take more of the parents' time or money to navigate, because the child can't do it on their own. As Darby Saxbe, a clinical psychologist, recently wrote in the New York Times, "underparenting requires structural change." Unlike most political experts, she's not just talking about economic policies like family leave and government-supported childcare. She's talking about actual physical structures, and the cultural change required to populate them. We need to "build back our tolerance for children in public spaces," she writes, "and create safe environments where lightly supervised kids can move around freely."
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 아이들이 독립적으로 자라려면 사회의 물리적 구조와 문화가 변해야 한다.

det.korean: 요지: 물리적 구조 + 문화 변화 → 아이 독립 가능
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 물리적 구조 + 문화 변화: 글의 요지
❌ ① 개인 양육만: structural change
❌ ② 경제 정책만: not just economic
❌ ④ 엄격한 감독: lightly supervised
